faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What services does SOENG DigitalCore provide?
faq.a1: SOENG DigitalCore provides digital development and design services for businesses, including Websites, Web Systems, Mobile Apps, Automation & Integration, UI/UX Design, and Graphic Design. We can support you from planning and design through development, delivery, and post-launch support.
faq.q2: I don't know what system I need. Can I discuss my needs first?
faq.a2: Absolutely. You can start by telling us about the problems your business is facing. You don't need to know exactly what system you need. We can help analyze your needs and recommend a suitable solution.
faq.q3: How is the service price determined?
faq.a3: Pricing depends on the project scope, number of features, design requirements, integrations, and specific business needs. Services with a clear starting price will show the price on their service page, while custom projects will be discussed before development.
faq.q4: How long does it take to complete a project?
faq.a4: The timeline depends on the size and complexity of the project. We will define the scope and timeline with you before starting.
faq.q5: Do you provide support after delivering a Website or System?
faq.a5: Each service has different warranty or support terms, which are shown on the Service Detail page. Changes or additional features outside the warranty may require an additional fee.
faq.q6: What do I need to prepare before starting a project?
faq.a6: Generally, you can prepare your project goals, business information, logo or brand assets, desired features, and examples you like. If you're not sure yet, we can start with a discussion about your needs.
faq.q7: How many revisions can I request?
faq.a7: During the UI/UX Design stage, you can request revisions until you are satisfied. After approving the design and moving into development, additional changes will depend on the agreed project scope.
faq.q8: How can I contact SOENG DigitalCore to start a project?
faq.a8: You can contact us through the communication channels available on our Website. Tell us what you want to build or what problem your business is facing, and we'll discuss your needs and the next steps.

story.title: About SOENG DigitalCore
story.intro: Starting from a simple idea to create digital solutions that deliver real value to businesses.
story.p1: As technology becomes an essential part of doing business, we believe businesses of all sizes should have access to quality digital solutions.
story.p2: SOENG DigitalCore was created to help businesses build quality, modern, and scalable Web & App solutions based on their actual needs.
story.p3: We believe a Website or system should be more than visually attractive. It should help businesses work more efficiently and remain easy to use over the long term.
story.p4: We pay attention to every stage of the process, from project discussion and planning to UI/UX Design, development, testing, and post-launch support.
story.p5: For us, success is not measured only by the number of completed projects, but by the value we create for businesses and the trust our clients place in us.
